ValidationRule.description: Account tier requires minimum annual spend (CASE) and Platinum accounts must have a website, a global territory and a phone.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account_Tier__c))), OR( NULLVALUE(Annual_Spend__c, 0) < CASE(TEXT(Account_Tier__c), 'Bronze', 0, 'Silver', 10000, 'Gold', 100000, 'Platinum', 1000000, 0), AND(ISPICKVAL(Account_Tier__c, 'Platinum'), OR(ISBLANK(Website), NOT(INCLUDES(Sales_Territories__c, 'Global')), ISBLANK(Phone))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Annual Spend or account contact data does not satisfy the account tier.
